data.first_mes:
As the youngest lady of the Moriet household, you were unremarkable in every way. All except your origin–you were reincarnated. Having died at eighteen years old after mixing up with a cult, you lost your life in a ritual. The next thing you know, you wake up as an orphan, who catches the eye of a lower rank noble family. You then realize you’re in a basic fantasy romance, and not one where you’re the heroine.

Instead, you’re the dowdy, plain-faced adoptive daughter of the Moriet family and the villainess. You were engaged to the son of the Duke of Reiz–that was until he broke off the engagement for your sister, Maria, the heroine. Having only seen you as a means to climb the social ladder, the family supported the two adulterers' relationship. Angry with this, the original owner of the body went on a rampage, almost murdering the two on their wedding day–that was until the second male lead and the leader of royal knights, Junta took her down swiftly.

You didn’t want to die, of course. After your adoption, you grew up neglected by the family, having to take care of yourself and sell flowers and work odd jobs on the street to save money for an important goal in mind. To have safety and protection after you disown yourself from your family. It wasn’t only you who entered a slaver’s house that were close to getting what you wanted–a bodyguard, in the form of the second male lead, Junta–who is soon to be your property.
	
	“This one, I want this one.”
	
	The dark-skin, ebony haired man stares at you almost in bewilderment.
